plate_direction: A deep navy field occupying the whole frame. In the lower right, large overlapping soft-edged circles in periwinkle and a lighter blue, arranged as a cluster that reads as an abstract diagram, with one thin white arc sweeping through them. The upper half and upper left are an unbroken flat navy expanse with no detail whatsoever, no gradient banding and no objects. Studio-clean, flat vector-like rendering, no photography, no devices, no screens, no hands, no people.
